description: NFTBan Metrics Registry - Single source of truth for all telemetry

go_nftban.description: Application-level operation metrics (bans, feeds, sync, auth, modules)

go_sampler.description: Daemon sampler metrics (blocks, network, health, sessions)

design_principles.producer_not_product: NFTBan is a metrics producer, not a monitoring product
design_principles.consumer_agnostic: Users choose how they ingest, store, and visualize
design_principles.stable_contract: Metric names and semantics are stable (semantic versioning)
design_principles.bounded_cardinality: Labels have bounded value sets to prevent explosion
design_principles.no_vendor_lock: OpenMetrics format works with any compatible backend
design_principles.local_retention_capped: Local storage limited to 4 weeks maximum

user_responsibilities: Install and configure scraping agent (Prometheus, vmagent, etc.)

local_retention.note: Long-term retention is user's responsibility via external TSDB

Pro module reads local data files (bans.log, metrics cache, reports) - exporter pipeline unchanged
